records.subject: spec-guard-claude
evidence: result:the plugin moved from 0.64.2 to 0.65.0 for scope user; the installed copy records gitCommitSha 0332f39 -- the v0.65.0 tag commit; it passes 361 phase-guard cases (one repository-file case is the known class), test_sibling_plugins and test_agent_relay_probe

result:in the same temporary project with delegate enabled in this machine's Claude config, the installed copy's phase-guard.sh carries the line proposing `/delegate:review` (whether it can run is decided by `/delegate:doctor`); after adding the decline marker the line is gone; with empty plugin records the 0.65.0 and 0.64.2 copies print byte-identical output

result:a real claude -p session asked to hand the Spec over for review proposed a read-only review via /delegate:review as advisory only, said it would start it only after the user agrees, and did not start it
